run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T21:58:39Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert is real and traces to the ad service's only pod being OOMKilled in a restart loop, leaving the ad Service with no ready endpoint. frontend's own error spans appear only on the /api/data route and its gRPC client span for grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, from ~21:59 to ~22:09 (peak 3.61 error spans/s, error ratio 8.3% at the 22:05:58 sample) against 0 errors in the pre-incident samples of the same series. Concurrently the ad service stopped emitting server spans (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 0 from ~22:03 while frontend's client span continued) and pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 shows container 'ad' terminated with reason OOMKilled / exitCode 137, restartCount 4, Ready False, and 23 BackOff events; the ad Service endpoint has only notReadyAddresses. Chaos Mesh events name the object applying memory stress to exactly that container: experiments spawned by Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (chaos-mesh) repeatedly report 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' from 21:56:44 onward, against an ad container memory limit of 450Mi. The Schedule object itself is a chaos-mesh CRD that the allowed read kinds do not cover, so its memory-stress parameters, creation time and any change history could not be verified, and Jaeger holds no traces after 21:48:55, so the exact gRPC failure code seen by frontend is unobserved. The causal attribution therefore rests on events plus the pod/endpoint object state, hence a partial conclusion.

claims.text: frontend error spans (status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) were 0 at the samples from 21:33:39 to 21:57:39, then 1.36/s at 21:59:39, 3.01-3.62/s between 22:01:39 and 22:07:39, 1.56/s at 22:09:39 and 0 at 22:11:39.

The only frontend span names carrying nonzero error rates are GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, each with the same rate, i.e. the failing path is frontend /api/data calling AdService/GetAds.

frontend's error-span ratio was 0 at the 21:35:58 and 21:50:58 samples and 0.0833 at the 22:05:58 sample; the 24h range query returned only those three points (source data starting 21:35:58), so no longer baseline exists for this series.

ad's server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fell from ~1.0/s (0.71/s at 21:59:00) to 0.27/s at 22:01:00 and 0 from 22:03:00 through 22:11:00, while frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds continued at ~1.02-1.08/s through 22:07:00, i.e. frontend kept calling ad while ad recorded no server spans.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958) is Running but not ready: container 'ad' shows state terminated with reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 22:00:55, lastState terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 at 21:59:53, restartCount 4, started false, and condition Ready=False (ContainersNotReady) since 22:00:56.

Events for ad-554b849958-l9ft5 include Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo' with count 23, last at 22:05:32, plus Normal Pulled/Created/Started each count 6.
The ad Service endpoint object lists only notReadyAddresses 100.96.2.230 (targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5) on port 8080, so the ad service has no ready backend.
Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has replicas 1 and container 'ad' (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) with resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi and requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi.

Chaos Mesh StressChaos events show repeated memory-stress experiments otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq, -7n9mk, -8b272, -sh425, -w8tqb, -w4ct8, -w98sl and -9ncrx, each with 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' (first at 21:56:44, last applied 22:03:34), each followed by TimeUp and 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad'; some attempts ended in Warning 'Failed to apply chaos: ... no running task found ...'.

Events on involvedObject.kind Schedule show the object otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh) creating those experiments: 'Create new object: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq' at 21:56:44 through '...-9ncrx' at 22:04:29, plus Warning Forbid events because a previous experiment was still running.

Per-container-id memory usage for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 shows successive short-lived ad container instances growing rapidly (e.g. c201... 2.56MiB at 21:57:00 to 63.77MiB; d11f... 2.19MiB at 21:58:15 to 175.39MiB at 21:59:00; 4d34... 2.46MiB at 22:02:30 to 117.98MiB at 22:04:00) and then no longer updating, consistent with rapid memory growth and container termination.
container_memory_failcnt for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is 0 across the sampled points, so that metric does not carry the OOM count.
frontend-proxy's own error spans rose on operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' from 0.0037-0.0148/s before 21:59 to 1.08-1.09/s at 22:03:00-22:07:00 (0.66 at 22:09:00, 0.21 at 22:11:00).

Of the 21 pods in namespace otel-demo, ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is the only one not ready and the only one with restarts (4); the other 20 pods are Running with ready true and restartCount 0, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-xfrh6, cart, checkout, product-catalog, recommendation and load-generator.

Error-span rates for the other services stayed flat through the window: accounting and payment 0, ad 0.0037/s at 21:47:39-21:53:39 and again 21:59:39-22:01:39, recommendation and fraud-detection ~0.0037/s spot values, while frontend rose to 3.6/s and frontend-proxy to 1.79/s.

Jaeger holds no traces from the incident window: a frontend trace search over 20:58:39-22:15:58 returned traces whose spans start at 21:48:54-21:48:55 only (all frontend/proxy spans HTTP 200, grpc status 0), and a search restricted to 21:55-22:15:58 returned no traces at all.

The ad container's readable log stream contained 2678 lines with the newest shown line at 21:56:44 ('Targeted ad request received for [assembly]' / 'no baggage found in context' lines, no error text) and the tool reported no previous container instance to read.

Rejected: node-level failure on node i-0d81a0f472ebdc704. All other pods on that node (accounting, cart, currency, email, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, otel-collector, postgresql, product-catalog, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) are ready with 0 restarts, and only the ad container was OOMKilled.

The ad service's own error spans did not increase: its only errored operation before and during the incident is flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at 0.0037/s (present at 21:47:39-21:53:39), and ad's getAdsByCategory/getRandomAds/oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans carry no STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase; ad's failure is at container/pod level (OOMKilled, removed from endpoints), not an application error response from ad.

Mechanism hypothesis: the memory stress applied to container otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad pushed its memory to the 450Mi limit, the container was OOMKilled repeatedly, the pod went ContainersNotReady and was removed from the ad Service endpoints, so frontend's gRPC calls to grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds from /api/data failed (frontend error spans, no ad server spans, ad endpoint only in notReadyAddresses). The literal gRPC status code / connection error text was not observed because Jaeger has no traces after 21:48:55 and frontend pod logs returned no lines.

Second candidate not fully excluded: the ad container's 450Mi limit may itself be marginal for the workload's baseline (working_set 316-355MiB before the incident), so the same OOM could recur under load without the stressor; this is a contributing-condition hypothesis, not an observed cause, and no memory-stress-free comparison period with equivalent traffic was available.

Have a human owner confirm whether the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh is intended to run against the ad pod; if it is a planned experiment, suspend or narrow it, and if not, remove it.

Review the ad container's 450Mi memory limit against its observed 316-355MiB steady-state working set, and consider making the frontend /api/data path degrade gracefully when grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds is unavailable so ad unavailability does not become a 8.3%-level frontend request error rate.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh objects themselves could not be read: the authorized kinds list has no chaos-mesh CRD (Schedule/StressChaos), so the memory-stress size, duration, interval, target selector and creation time of Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress are unknown; the events are the only evidence for what it applied.
change_history is not integrated, so when the Schedule was created or last modified, and whether a human applied it as part of an experiment, cannot be determined.

Jaeger contains no spans after 21:48:55 in the queried window, so the exact error status/code on frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span and whether any ad server span exists after 22:07 is not observed; span counts come from traces_span_metrics, not from traces.

No frontend application log lines were retrievable (fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned zero lines, previous instance unavailable), so no error text such as a connection error was read; the ad container's previous instance logs were unavailable too and the current stream's newest readable line is 21:56:44.

rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count had no series in the window, so gRPC client status codes are unavailable, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready/available for deployment ad returned nothing (series absent for that selector).

Prometheus samples end at 22:11:39 (data_as_of 22:11:39): the frontend error rate is 0 at that last sample while the ad pod was still not ready and absent from endpoints at 22:16:51, and whether the alert recovered, and why overall frontend span rates dropped at 22:09-22:11, are unknown.

Events in namespace data-recorders (Job SuccessfulCreate/Completed, PVC Provisioning, Pod FailedScheduling/Killing) and the PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete were observed in another namespace and were not examined further; nothing ties them to this alert, and they are recorded as not investigated rather than as impact.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). <none> means the path reached no value in that object, not that the field is absent from the kind; a filtered table is not a full picture of the kind.

view.series_note: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation of the service (internal, client and server spans alike), summed over the labels kept in this query; it is not a count of requests. status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status; it does not mean the call succeeded.
